question_en: Track how Huawei's resolution-contribution rate changed over meetings (influence trend).
original_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WITH m, count(r) AS total MATCH (r2:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Huawei'}), (r2)-[:MADE_AT]->(m) WITH m, total, count(DISTINCT r2) AS huaweiCount RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber, m.meetingNumberInt, huaweiCount, total, round(100.0 * huaweiCount / total, 1) AS ratio ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt ASC

semantic_units.judgment: The requested result is a meeting-associated Huawei contribution-rate series, not only meeting IDs. A causal influence effect or approved/adopted authorship is not a new answer requirement. Auxiliary counts explain the rate; no scoring contract is admitted here.

Retain all3773 recorded Resolution nodes over58 meetings for the denominator. The original second inner MATCH yields52 positive meetings. The shared default Top10 and an amended linked-only denominator are not allowed to replace this item. The disputed issue is the documentary reference ownership within a recorded Resolution content unit, not requiring an exhaustive new physical Resolution census. In CON106 the original own label is plural conclusions, followed by an initial CMCC TP and separately headed MDT and Huawei L1/L2 email presentations. Whole-container versus one-presentation ownership is a real source-unit distinction.

The original P2 documentary proxy is supported: content full7digit R2 references join to existing Phase1 Tdocs and their formal Source company. All1716 referenced Huawei documents were checked in retained original formal registers. This does not authorize adding causality, endorsement or approval. However the source unit to which a successor presentation belongs cannot be decided from metadata shape alone. Original INDEX extraction lacks a Tdoc/email terminator, strongly supporting the broad captured-body interpretation. A first-entry cutoff rejects explicit above-agreement references in three #104 source witnesses. Conversely #100 contains a distinct later uplink-TA presentation after an RNTI decision, and #101 has a literal old-year number resolving to an unrelated Huawei CR although own prose names a ZTE LS and the matching ZTE LS is retained. Literal full-body extraction and intended own-reference interpretation therefore are not interchangeable source claims.

The unit is DISTINCT Resolution per company, not referenced-Tdoc count or path count. The unchanged original graph has742 Huawei-positive Resolutions and1764 paths. Changing the disputed CON106 membership alone changes #106 from17/72=23.6% to16/72=22.2%; the denominator stays72. These are one-witness counterfactuals, not validated whole alternative series. No candidate92/107 is adopted.
